opportunities.name: United flight search by origin, destination and dates
opportunities.description: Search United for a flight by entering an origin city or airport, a destination, travel dates (one-way or roundtrip), and passenger/cabin settings, then running Find flights.
steps: Click the 'Flying from' / departing combobox and type the origin city or airport code.
Select the matching origin suggestion from the dropdown.
Click the destination combobox, type the destination city or airport, and select the matching suggestion.
Set the search type (Roundtrip or One-way) if needed; use Flexible dates if the trip has no fixed dates.
Open the Depart date field and navigate the calendar (Move forward/backward to switch month) to pick the depart date, and the return date for roundtrips.
Adjust passengers (Adult/Child add or subtract buttons) and cabin (e.g. Economy or Premium economy) if specified.
Click 'Find flights' (or 'Search') to run the search and review results.

opportunities.name: SpotHero event parking search with filters and booking
opportunities.description: Find parking near a sports or entertainment venue by searching the venue, choosing a specific event (optionally a date), applying accessibility filters, and setting sort and start/end times before booking.
steps: Type the venue name into 'Search for parking' and select the matching suggestion.
Click the event in the event list (e.g. the game matchup).
If the event date is required, click 'Select Event Date' and choose the day cell.
Click 'Filter', tick the accessibility option (e.g. Wheelchair Accessible) and click 'Show N Results'.
Set 'Sort by' (Distance or Price) and the Start Time / End Time selects.
Click 'Update Search' if times were changed, then click 'Book Now' on the chosen listing.

opportunities.name: TripAdvisor restaurant search by destination with cuisine and price filters
opportunities.description: Open TripAdvisor restaurants, search a destination, open its restaurant list, and narrow it by cuisine and other filters such as outdoor seating.
steps: Click the 'Restaurants' category link.
Type the destination into the search box and select the matching location suggestion.
On the restaurant list, click 'Show more' under the cuisine filters if needed, tick the cuisine label, and click 'Apply'.
Optionally tick other filters (e.g. 'Outdoor Seating') or click 'Limit search to <location>'.

Destination Los Angeles; cuisine Indian; Apply; Limit search to Los Angeles.
Destination Big Sur, CA; selected Big Sur suggestion; Outdoor Seating filter ticked.

opportunities.name: TripAdvisor Trip Designer questionnaire
opportunities.description: Fill in the Trip Designer questionnaire on TripAdvisor by entering destination, dates, travel party (kids, group type), dietary needs, budget and interests, stepping through with Next.
steps: Click 'Hire a Trip Designer' and choose the trip-design start option (e.g. Get Started).
Type and select the destination.
Pick start and end dates in the calendar.
Choose the trip type (e.g. Family Vacation) and any dietary preference (e.g. Kosher), clicking Next between steps.
Set the number of children by clicking '+' or typing the count into the age spinbutton.
Select the budget option (e.g. $4,000 or $6,000) and click Next.
Pick interests (e.g. Must See Attractions, Local Cuisine, History) if asked.

instances.values: Destination Egypt (after a mistyped 'San Franciso' entry); dates Jul 1 - Jul 4 2023; Family Vacation; Kosher; 8 children; budget $4,000.
Budget $6,000, Next; interests Must See Attractions, Local Cuisine, History. Destination and earlier steps not captured in this segment, so the match is partial.
